```protocol-7
# Module: coding.helper.enforce_quota
# Purpose: Enforce per-job byte quotas with warning logging

module coding.helper.enforce_quota

# Reads the per-job byte quota from config, defaulting to 4096
# Returns the quota value as an integer
function get_quota() -> integer
    var config_path = config_path("jobs.quota")
    var quota_value = config_get_integer(config_path)
    return if quota_value == 0 then 4096 else quota_value
end

# Enforces the quota for a given job and its current usage
# Returns TRUE if within quota, FALSE if exceeded
# Logs a warning when exceeded
function enforce_quota(job_id: string, usage: integer) -> boolean
    var quota = get_quota()
    var job_name = job_name(job_id)
    
    if usage > quota then
        log_warning(
            "Job %s exceeded byte quota: %d / %d bytes",
            job_name,
            usage,
            quota
        )
        return FALSE
    end
    
    return TRUE
end

# Enforces the quota for an entire job (summing all segments)
# Returns TRUE if within quota, FALSE if exceeded
# Logs a warning when exceeded
function enforce_quota_job(job_id: string) -> boolean
    var quota = get_quota()
    var total_usage = job_usage(job_id)
    
    if total_usage > quota then
        log_warning(
            "Job %s exceeded byte quota: %d / %d bytes",
            job_name(job_id),
            total_usage,
            quota
        )
        return FALSE
    end
    
    return TRUE
end

# Registers the module functions
register_function(get_quota)
register_function(enforce_quota)
register_function(enforce_quota_job)
```

This module provides three key functions:

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `get_quota()` | Reads quota from config `[default 4096]` |
| `enforce_quota(job_id, usage)` | Checks single-value usage against quota |
| `enforce_quota_job(job_id)` | Checks total job usage (summed) against quota |

Both enforcement functions log a warning and return `FALSE` when usage exceeds the quota, returning `TRUE` otherwise.
